All code is base `R`. Every number quoted on the Session 21 slides can be reproduced here.

## Mean: $z$ and $t$ intervals

```{r}
# z interval, sigma known (battery example)
11.2 + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * 2.4 / sqrt(36)

# t interval, mtcars
x <- mtcars$mpg; n <- length(x)
t.test(x)$conf.int
mean(x) + c(-1, 1) * qt(0.975, n - 1) * sd(x) / sqrt(n)   # by hand
qt(0.975, c(2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 100))                       # t critical values
```

## Coverage by simulation

```{r}
set.seed(21)
mu <- 50; sigma <- 10; n <- 25
hit <- replicate(10000, {
  xb <- mean(rnorm(n, mu, sigma))
  abs(xb - mu) < qnorm(0.975) * sigma / sqrt(n)
})
mean(hit)          # close to 0.95
```

## Proportions: Wald and Wilson

```{r}
x <- 148; n <- 400; ph <- x / n
ph + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(ph * (1 - ph) / n)    # Wald
prop.test(x, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int                 # Wilson
prop.test(3, 20, correct = FALSE)$conf.int                # small n: Wilson
0.15 + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(0.15 * 0.85 / 20)   # small n: Wald goes negative
```

## Variance: chi-square interval

```{r}
x <- mtcars$mpg; n <- length(x); s2 <- var(x)
ci <- (n - 1) * s2 / qchisq(c(0.975, 0.025), n - 1)
ci; sqrt(ci)

# Fragility: coverage with non-normal data (n = 20)
cover <- function(gen, sig2, n = 20, B = 20000) mean(replicate(B, {
  ci <- (n - 1) * var(gen(n)) / qchisq(c(0.975, 0.025), n - 1)
  ci[1] < sig2 && sig2 < ci[2] }))
c(normal = cover(rnorm, 1), t5 = cover(function(n) rt(n, 5), 5 / 3),
  uniform = cover(runif, 1 / 12), exponential = cover(rexp, 1))
```

## Sample size

```{r}
ceiling((qnorm(0.975) * 15 / 2)^2)             # mean, sigma = 15, E = 2
ceiling(qnorm(0.975)^2 * 0.25 / 0.03^2)        # proportion, E = 0.03, p = 1/2
```

## Two samples

```{r}
a <- ToothGrowth$len[ToothGrowth$supp == "OJ"]
b <- ToothGrowth$len[ToothGrowth$supp == "VC"]
t.test(a, b)$conf.int                          # Welch
t.test(a, b, var.equal = TRUE)$conf.int        # pooled

p1 <- 120 / 400; p2 <- 90 / 350
(p1 - p2) + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(p1 * (1 - p1) / 400 + p2 * (1 - p2) / 350)
```
